answer: A farm therefore pays the burn once for each alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The sable debit happens at intake, sonnet totals the burned amount, and bridge anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 24 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Verification alone takes 8 days each. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
